release_title: MedCore Platinum v1.0.0 Parity RC-5 (Arabic-First + Secure LAN Gateway + 20 Gap Closure)
certification_rationale: All 20 functional parity gaps (GAP-001 to GAP-020) and all 27 automated software gates (Gates 00-26) passed with 100% zero defects across 78 automated tests (58 Desktop tests, 12 Domain Backend tests, 8 Secure LAN Gateway tests). Physical multi-workstation test over real external LAN awaits second physical laptop execution by hospital IT technicians.
